faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about orders, delivery and products.
faqPage.noResultsHint: Try a different phrase or pick another category.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Open the Shop, add products to your cart, and proceed to checkout summary. To place the order, you need a CUSTOMER account and confirmed 18+ age.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: Yes, but only at an early stage. If the order is already in production, packing, or delivery, cancellation may no longer be available.

items.question: Can I place an order as a guest?
items.answer: You can browse and use the cart as a guest, but final order placement requires a customer account and age confirmation.

items.question: Are different capacities (e.g. 500 ml and 700 ml) separate products?
items.answer: Yes. Capacity variants are treated as separate products, so they can have different prices and stock.

items.question: Which payment methods are available?
items.answer: In the current project stage, payment flow is simplified. The frontend is prepared for full payment integration on the API side.

items.question: Why is there no dedicated payment screen yet?
items.answer: This is a student project phase. We prioritized cart, order lifecycle, tracking, and security first, then payment gateway integration.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 1 to 3 business days, depending on region and courier workload.

items.question: Can I track my package?
items.answer: Yes. Use the Order Status page with order number and email. Logged-in customers also get richer details in My Orders.

items.question: Do you ship outside Poland?
items.answer: At the moment, this project assumes domestic delivery. International shipping can be added in later iterations.

items.question: Do products have full descriptions?
items.answer: Yes. Product descriptions are loaded from the API, so content can be updated on the backend without frontend code changes.

items.question: Are the prices final?
items.answer: Prices shown in the catalog come from the API. In test environments they may be demo values, but the mechanism is production-like.

items.question: Where do product images come from?
items.answer: In this project, product icons are maintained on the frontend, while descriptions and numeric product data come from the API.

items.question: Do I need an account to add products to the cart?
items.answer: No. The cart works locally and does not require login.

items.question: Why do I need to confirm age 18+?
items.answer: This is required for alcohol sales. Underage users can browse the page, but cannot place orders.

items.question: Why was I logged out automatically?
items.answer: For security reasons, the session may end after inactivity or token expiration. In that case, sign in again.

items.question: Can I use the site in English and dark mode?
items.answer: Yes. You can switch language (PL/EN) and light/dark mode from the top navigation bar.
